scope: Current geographic reference areas for all world region filters except unclassified; no historical polity boundaries.
coordinateSystem: WGS84 longitude, latitude; D3 clockwise exterior rings
processing: Source polygons repaired with make_valid, dissolved by named memberships, topology-preserving simplification 0.02 degrees, 5 decimal precision, edges densified at 1 degree for spherical projection. Source conversion seams within 0.0005 degrees of the antimeridian and 0.01 degrees of a pole are snapped to the exact meridian/pole to preserve spherical closure. No minimum island area filter. The Arctic uses the source Arctic Circle's north-side cap. Overseas map units retain their own geographic classification; transcontinental portions use source continent/island outlines.
limitations: Natural Earth generalizes current reference geography and uses de facto country boundaries; it is not a legal boundary dataset.
The UN M49 statistical baseline is adjusted for explicit physical transcontinental/island geography; it is not a claim that UN M49 subdivides those countries.
Overlapping seas may belong to multiple ocean filters. Other waters are the geometric difference of all eligible named marine polygons and the explicit marine groups.
Named marine source geometry excludes Caspian Sea, Garabogaz Bay, river reaches, reefs and unnamed internal-water labels.
Unclassified has no fabricated area. Source coastlines can differ slightly from the base map and recorded coastal point coordinates.
